title: Fix Delete Story Diff And Output Never Loading
description: In semio algorithms Storybook, the Delete story's Diff and Output windows are stuck on "Loading delete result (...)" forever. Root cause: Delete.stories.tsx uses `diffRes.change.forward`, but `nativeDeletePieces` returns `DesignDiffOperationResult` where `change` is the `DesignDiff` directly (no `.forward`). As a result `designDiff` stays undefined and the loading error text persists. Fix by setting `designDiff` to `diffRes.change`.
summary: Renamed the semio server subsystem to semio hub across the semio/ technology. Cargo package & binary renamed from "semio-session" to "semio-hub" (Cargo.toml). Compose: service key session→hub, working_dir semio/server→semio/hub, DB name semio_session→semio_hub, RUST_LOG filter semio_session→semio_hub, region 🔖Session→🔖Hub. K8s: namespace/service/deployment/labels/image/env filters all session/semio-session→hub/semio-hub; SessionService/SessionDeployment regions→HubService/HubDeployment; ingress backend session→hub. bin.rs: log tag, default EnvFilter, and default DATABASE_URL all semio_session→semio_hub. .vscode/launch.json: launcher name 📚server→📚hub and `cargo run -p semio-session`→`cargo run -p semio-hub`. sketchpad/index.tsx, engine/main.py, js/index.ts, desktop/renderer.tsx, DOCS.md: user-facing strings and specs "semio server" / "semio/server" / "semio-session" → "semio hub" / "semio/hub" / "semio-hub". Removed the now-empty semio/server directory. repo/ was intentionally not touched (different technology; SEMIO_SERVER_* env vars belong to the repo server).
